query: We're cutting a release on Friday and the docs are a mess - half the TODOs in HANDOFF.md are already done, ROADMAP.md still mentions features we shipped six months ago, and there are three different files in the root called handoff-final.md, handoff-v2-FINAL.md, and handoff-actually-final.md. Need to clean this up before the tag.

i have a CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and GEMINI.md in this repo and they all say slightly different things about how to run the tests and they all have different rules about commits. need to pick a source of truth and make the rest point to it

Our README quickstart says `npm run start` but that script doesn't exist in package.json anymore. There's also a whole section about a Redis cache we ripped out last year. Can you audit the README against the actual repo and fix the drift?

im in a monorepo with 8 packages under packages/. each one has its own README and theyve all drifted from the actual code. we renamed two services last quarter (notifications -> messaging, billing -> payments) and the old names still show up in like a dozen places. wanna do a cleanup pass before the new hires start

Can you audit the docs/ directory in our repo? I think there's a lot of cruft in there - planning docs from 2023, screenshots from the v1 UI we replaced, a folder called docs/old-migrations/ that I'm pretty sure nothing references anymore. Figure out what's still relevant and what should be deleted or archived.
documentation governance pass please. README, agent instruction files, the handoff doc, the planning notes - the works. produce a PR I can review, dont merge anything

the AGENTS.md i wrote myself has gotten huge and i think a bunch of it duplicates the actual code and CI config. also there's an old CLAUDE.md that contradicts it in a few places. consolidate them down to what actually matters and have one of them be the canonical file

new dev couldnt get the project running from the README alone, took them 2 hours of slack pings to figure out the env setup. plus we have 4 different .env.example files at various paths and im not sure which one is current. fix the onboarding docs

this repo has zero documentation - no README, no AGENTS.md, no architecture notes, nothing. i inherited it from a contractor who's gone. can you set up the standard documentation files based on what you can figure out from the code and ci?

noticed our docs/ARCHITECTURE.md links to like 12 other markdown files and half of them 404. plus the architecture description references a `MetricsCollector` service that we deleted in Q1. think the whole docs folder needs an audit
audit my CLAUDE.md and tell me what's outdated or vague. just the one file - it's at the repo root, called CLAUDE.md
this is a fresh repo, no CLAUDE.md yet. initialize a CLAUDE.md with the codebase basics so Claude Code has context next time i open this
add a 'Configuration' section to my README under the 'Quick Start' section explaining the OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and OAUTH_SECRET env vars - they're documented in src/config/oauth.ts
our docs build is failing in github actions, mkdocs is throwing 'config file at mkdocs.yml not found' even though it's clearly there. can you debug what's wrong with the workflow
generate JSDoc comments for all the exported functions in src/utils/ - they currently have no inline documentation
review the PR i just pushed - branch is `feature/payment-webhooks`. focus on the webhook signature verification logic in src/webhooks/stripe.ts
Generate a CHANGELOG entry for v2.4.0 based on the merge commits between v2.3.0 and HEAD. Include sections for Added/Changed/Fixed.
translate our README.md to brazilian portuguese and save it as README.pt-BR.md
set up a Docusaurus docs site under docs/site/ for our public-facing API documentation - this will eventually deploy to docs.example.com
help me write a better git commit message for the changes i just staged. they touch a bunch of files in src/auth/ and i want a clear summary
